Elections

EventItemActionText: The Rules, Confirmations, and Public Elections Committee recommended the nominees. The President called for an election to fill one vacancy on the Human Relations Commission. Nominations previously made were Christy Borthick. The following vote was taken on the nominated candidates: Christy Borthick (21): Allen, Hill, Kimbrough, Cortese, Webb, Eslick, Evans, Bradford, Huffman, Gregg, Cash, Kupin, Taylor, Johnston, Nash, Benton, Ellis, Rutherford, Styles, Ewing, and Spain; Abstain (10): Porterfield, Evans-Segall, Toombs, Gamble, Harrell, Welsch, Vo, Gadd, Preptit, Sepulveda. The president declared that Christy Borthick was elected to the Commission.
EventItemTitle:
Human Relations Commission
Consideration of nominees to fill one vacancy on the Commission with a term expiring April 18, 2027, with an election to be held at the October 6, 2026 Council meeting.
·	Christy Borthick nominated by CM Eslick

EventItemActionText: The President called for an election to fill one vacancy on the Contract and Compliance Board for a non-voting member of the Metropolitan Council. Nominations previously made were CM Deonté Harrell. The following vote was taken on the nominated candidates: Deonté Harrell (34): Suara, Porterfield, Evans-Segall, Allen, Hill, Kimbrough, Toombs, Gamble, Cortese, Capp, Benedict, Harrell, Webb, Eslick, Evans, Bradford, Huffman, Gregg, Welsch, Vo, Cash, Kupin, Taylor, Gadd, Preptit, Johnston, Nash, Benton, Ellis, Sepulveda, Rutherford, Styles, Ewing, and Spain; Abstain (0). The president declared that Deonté Harrell was elected to the Board.
EventItemTitle:
Contract and Compliance Board
Consideration of nominee to fill one vacancy on the Board for a non-voting member from the Metropolitan Council with a term expiring August 31, 2027, with an election to be conducted at the October 6, 2026 Council meeting.

Public Comment Period

EventItemActionText:
Council Member Horton moved to suspend Rule 15.1 of the Rules of Procedure of the Council to change the Capital Improvement Budget request submission deadline from October 31, 2026 to November 9, 2026. Without objection, the Rule is suspended.
Council Member Horton moved to suspend Rule 15.2 of the Rules of Procedure of the Council to change the deadline for the Capital Improvement Budget report prepared by the Planning Department from December 16, 2026 to December 31, 2026. Without objection, the Rule is suspended.
EventItemTitle: Rules of Procedure

EventItemActionText: The Rule 21 amendment was approved with a substitute by the Rules, Confirmations, and Public Elections Committee. Council Member Spain moved to adopt the Rule amendment, which motion was properly seconded. Council Member Spain moved to suspend the Rules of Procedure to offer a late filed substitute Rule amendment. Without objection, Council Member Spain offered a substitute Rule amendment and moved that it be adopted, which motion was seconded and approved by a voice vote of the Council. Council Member Spain moved to adopt the Rule amendment as substituted, which motion was seconded and approved by a voice vote of the Council.
EventItemTitle: Amendment to Rules of Procedure, Rule 21 - Legislation concerning appropriation of funds
